## de6d50ef73a3

**Reproduced defect — ignored and under-validated declared overrides.** Under assigned generator SHA-256 `bad7983cfc96367d3e9b33770d73cdf1362a9b5f2ca1aed43cbe6869c09e25c6`, seed `314159`, sample index `7`, and `grid_h=8`, `grid_w=10`, `shape_choice=0` and `shape_choice=3` produce byte-identical grids. Likewise, `palette_kind="warm"` and `palette_kind="cool"` produce identical grids. The out-of-range declared-axis override `shape_choice=99` is accepted instead of rejected.

The generated witness passes `self_check` and belongs to the documented single compact nonzero-object domain. I also ran the canonical Racket authority on it; the retained output is valid under rule hash `6806b894d39b`. Exact generation grids, overrides, hashes, validator status, and authority command are in `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/counterexample.json`; raw authority output is `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/racket.json`. This is an audit-only finding; no source for this task was changed.

## de6d50ef73a3

**Status: reproduced defects; source left unchanged.** Generator version `1.2.0`, SHA-256 `bad7983cfc96367d3e9b33770d73cdf1362a9b5f2ca1aed43cbe6869c09e25c6`; canonical rule hash `6806b894d39b`.

### A1 — Validator and distribution exclude the canonical multicolour object language

The task moves the tight crop of one nonzero object to the top-left, and canonical objects may contain several colours. The current `_components` routine instead computes **same-colour** connected components and `self_check` requires exactly one of them. It therefore rejects all 5 canonical inputs: observed messages include “saw 2” and “saw 3” components. Even the single-colour canonical case is split into two same-colour regions and rejected.

The generator itself always paints one monochrome four-cell shape. In a deterministic sample of 60 default draws—20 per band, seed `7000+i`, sample index `i`, `i=0..19`—all 60 had exactly one nonzero colour. The profile stage found 0/60 exact canonical-profile hits and zero exact support in every band. This makes “find one monochrome component” a generator shortcut and prevents training on preservation of internal multicolour structure.

Evidence: `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/counterexample.json` and `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/profile/checks/de6d50ef73a3_before_profile_floor.json`.

### A2 — Advertised `shape_choice` is ignored and invalid/unknown controls are silently accepted

At seed `314159`, sample index `7`, difficulty `medium`, `grid_h=8`, `grid_w=10`, both `shape_choice=0` and `shape_choice=3` return the identical grid SHA-256 `5971a23120eb4c280d89c407f76908f808537013dbcaef768fb1350463eac3ee`. The out-of-range value `shape_choice=99` and an unknown key also return that same grid rather than failing. The generated input passes the target's current validator, and canonical Racket application returns a valid top-left crop, so this is a generator-contract defect rather than an invalid-input artifact.

Racket-bound reproducer: `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/input.json`, `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/racket.json`, and compact `checks/audit/de6d50ef73a3/counterexample.json`.

**Suggested repair, not applied.** Treat all nonzero 4-connected cells as the single movable object regardless of colour; construct multicolour canonical-profile objects; make `shape_choice` select the requested template; reject unknown/out-of-range overrides; pin the current canonical rule hash.
